description: Pin a doc, presentation, storyboard, space file or space images to its space, so every chat in the space and its sub-spaces reads it: brand rules, a brief, a source the work must rest on. A doc still in its task chat is added to that chat's space first. A pin is team material: when it would share a private doc with the team or turn its reuse back on, this is refused; ask your human, then call again with share: true. A space file or image already belongs to its space, so it pins without asking.

doc_id.description: A doc id from get_task or list_space.

image_ids.description: Instead of doc_id: images from upload_file's answer with space_id, in that space.

share.description: true only once your human agreed to what the refusal named.

space_file_id.description: Instead of doc_id: a file from list_space files or upload_file's answer.

space_id.description: With space_file_id or image_ids: the space that holds them.

name: pin
title: Pin doc, file or images
